answer: Random beacon spot-checks stop mass fake identities. Each epoch a random beacon picks 5% of agents, each to solve a live compute puzzle in 90s; a juniper proves life by growing. The honest network is an oasis, its meadow of rewards open only to passers. Faking 1,000 identities needs 1,000 heartbeats at $0.02 an hour, $480 a day; one honest agent pays $0.48 and keeps its full share. Miss a check and the identity freezes, its deposit slashed.
